hero.heading: About Our Clinic
hero.subheading: Serving the Fox Valley community with compassionate, expert care since 1990.

story.heading: Our Story
paragraphs: Fox Valley Physical Therapy & Wellness was established in 1990 by Steve Sobojinski, Regina Sobojinski, and Patti Ahrens with a simple mission: to provide the highest quality rehabilitation care in a personal, private setting.

Over three decades later, that mission remains at the heart of everything we do. Our 7,500 square-foot facility — featuring a therapeutic pool and fully equipped gym — has helped over 35,000 patients recover from injuries, surgeries, and chronic conditions.

We treat your injuries as if they were our own. That philosophy drives us to stay current with the latest evidence-based techniques while never losing sight of the personal touch that makes our clinic special.

items.title: Personalized Care
items.description: Every treatment plan is tailored to your specific needs, goals, and lifestyle. You're never just a number here.

items.title: Expert Team
items.description: Our 14-member team brings over 100 years of combined experience across physical therapy, occupational therapy, and athletic training.

items.title: Advanced Facilities
items.description: Our therapeutic pool and fully equipped gym provide treatment options that most clinics simply can't offer.

items.title: Community Trust
items.description: Voted the top private practice in Winnebago County, we've earned our reputation through decades of results.

team.heading: Meet Our Team
team.subheading: Dedicated professionals committed to your recovery

members.name: Steve Sobojinski
members.bio: Steve co-founded the clinic in 1990 and specializes in upper extremity rehabilitation. His expertise in occupational therapy and strength conditioning helps patients regain full function after hand, wrist, and arm injuries.

members.name: Regina Sobojinski
members.bio: Regina has been a cornerstone of Fox Valley PT since its founding. Her decades of clinical experience and compassionate approach have helped thousands of patients achieve their rehabilitation goals.

members.name: Dr. Jordan Kasper
members.bio: Dr. Kasper brings a modern, evidence-based approach to physical therapy, helping patients recover from a wide range of orthopedic and musculoskeletal conditions.

members.name: Dr. Stephanie Meyer
members.bio: Dr. Meyer is certified in trigger point dry needling, offering advanced pain relief techniques alongside traditional physical therapy approaches.

members.name: Dr. Courtney Disterhaft
members.bio: Dr. Disterhaft specializes in pediatric therapy, vestibular rehabilitation, and neurological conditions, providing expert care for patients of all ages.

members.name: Dr. Jensen Pearson
members.bio: Dr. Pearson focuses on sports medicine, pediatric care, and vestibular rehabilitation, helping athletes and young patients get back to their active lifestyles.

members.name: Dr. Bridget Thiel
members.bio: Dr. Thiel brings expertise in spinal disorders and chronic pain management, helping patients find lasting relief through targeted therapy programs.

members.name: Darrick Lang
members.bio: With the clinic since 2005, Darrick specializes in wound care, upper extremity rehabilitation, and custom splinting.

members.name: Courtney Baumann
members.bio: Courtney has been a valued member of our team since 2015, providing hands-on patient care and rehabilitation support.

members.name: Deborah Tomasi
members.bio: Deborah focuses on functional fitness and healthy aging, helping patients maintain their independence and quality of life.

members.name: Josie Arneson
members.bio: With the clinic since 2016, Josie specializes in aquatic therapy, orthopedics, and pediatrics, leveraging our therapeutic pool for effective treatment.

members.name: Lucie Nezbed
members.bio: Lucie brings expertise in orthopedics and pediatrics, providing compassionate care for patients recovering from musculoskeletal injuries.

members.name: Darren Hanusa
members.bio: Darren has been with the clinic since 1998 and specializes in knee and ankle injury rehabilitation, sports conditioning, and athletic performance.

members.name: Paula Clark
members.bio: Paula has managed clinic operations and billing since 1993. She's your go-to resource for insurance questions and appointment scheduling.
